074        public void saveControlState(ShipAPI ship) {
075                prevState = savedState;
076                savedState = new SavedShipControlState();
077                savedState.ship = ship;
078                for (WeaponGroupAPI group : ship.getWeaponGroupsCopy()) {
079                        savedState.autofiring.put(group, group.isAutofiring());
080                }
081                savedState.selected = ship.getSelectedGroupAPI();
082        }
083        public void restoreControlState(ShipAPI ship) {
084                if (ship == null) {
085                        return;
086                }
087                
088                if (prevState == null || prevState.ship != ship) {
089                        List<WeaponGroupAPI> groups = ship.getWeaponGroupsCopy();
090                        int index = 0;
091                        for (WeaponGroupSpec groupSpec : ship.getVariant().getWeaponGroups()) {
092                                if (index >= groups.size()) break;
093                                
094                                boolean auto = groupSpec.isAutofireOnByDefault();
095                                WeaponGroupAPI group = groups.get(index);
096                                if (group != null) {
097                                        if (auto) {
098                                                group.toggleOn();
099                                        } else {
100                                                group.toggleOff();
101                                        }
102                                }
103                                index++;
104                        }
105                        if (groups.size() >= 1) {
106                                ship.giveCommand(ShipCommand.SELECT_GROUP, null, 0);
107                        }
108                        return;
109                }
110                
111                
112                for (WeaponGroupAPI group : ship.getWeaponGroupsCopy()) {
113                        Boolean auto = prevState.autofiring.get(group);
114                        if (auto == null) auto = false;
115                        if (auto) {
116                                group.toggleOn();
117                        } else {
118                                group.toggleOff();
119                        }
120                }
121                int index = ship.getWeaponGroupsCopy().indexOf(prevState.selected);
122                if (index > 0) {
123                        ship.giveCommand(ShipCommand.SELECT_GROUP, null, index);
124                }
125        }

127        public void advance(float amount, List<InputEventAPI> events) {
128                if (engine == null) return;
129                if (engine.isPaused()) return;
130                
131                
132                ShipAPI playerShip = engine.getPlayerShip();
133                if (playerShip == null) {
134                        return;
135                }
136
137                if (!playerShip.isAlive()) {
138                        untilTransfer = 0f;
139                        lastShownTime = 0;
140                }
141                
142                if (untilTransfer > 0) {
143                        float timeMult = playerShip.getMutableStats().getTimeMult().getModifiedValue();
144                        untilTransfer -= amount * timeMult;
145                        
146                        Global.getSoundPlayer().applyLowPassFilter(0.75f, 0f);
147//                      Global.getSoundPlayer().applyLowPassFilter(1f - (1f - spec.getFilterGain()) * level * mult, 
148//                                      1f - (1f - spec.getFilterGainHF()) * level * mult);
149                        //engine.getCombatUI().setShipInfoFanOutBrightness(0f);
150                        engine.getCombatUI().hideShipInfo();
151                        if (untilTransfer <= 0) {
152                                untilTransfer = 0;
153                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_neural_transfer_complete", 1f, 1f);
154                                playerShip.setCustomData(TRANSFER_COMPLETE_KEY, true);
155                                showTranferFloatyIfNeeded();
156                                engine.getCombatUI().reFanOutShipInfo();
157                                boolean autopilot = engine.getCombatUI().isAutopilotOn();
158                                if (autopilot) {
159                                        if (playerShip.getAI() == null) { // somehow?
160                                                CombatFleetManagerAPI manager = engine.getFleetManager(FleetSide.PLAYER);
161                                                DeployedFleetMemberAPI member = manager.getDeployedFleetMember(playerShip);
162                                                playerShip.setShipAI(Global.getSettings().pickShipAIPlugin(member == null ? null : member.getMember(), playerShip));
163                                        }
164                                } else {
165                                        playerShip.setShipAI(null);
166                                        restoreControlState(playerShip);
167                                }
168                        } else {
169                                suppressControlsDuringTransfer(playerShip);
170                                showTranferFloatyIfNeeded();
171                        }
172                }
173                
174                // if the player changed flagships:
175                // skip a few frames to make sure the status ends up on top of the status list
176                if (playerShip != prevPlayerShip) {
177                        prevPlayerShip = playerShip;
178                        skipFrames = 30;
179                }
180                
181                if (skipFrames > 0) {
182                        skipFrames--;
183                        return;
184                }
185                
186                updateLinkState();
187        }

189        public void suppressControlsDuringTransfer(ShipAPI playerShip) {
190                if (ALLOW_ENGINE_CONTROL_DURING_TRANSFER) {
191                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.FIRE);
192                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.TOGGLE_AUTOFIRE);
193                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.PULL_BACK_FIGHTERS);
194                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.VENT_FLUX);
195                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.USE_SELECTED_GROUP);
196                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.USE_SYSTEM);
197                        playerShip.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.HOLD_FIRE);
198                } else {
199                        engine.getCombatUI().setDisablePlayerShipControlOneFrame(true);
200                }
201        }

229        public boolean canLink(ShipAPI ship) {
230                // below line: debug, work for every ship
231                //if (ship.isAlive() && !ship.isShuttlePod()) return true;
232                
233                ShipAPI playerShip = engine.getPlayerShip();
234                // transferred command to officer'ed ship, can't link
235                if (ship == playerShip && ship.getOriginalCaptain() != null && 
236                                !ship.getOriginalCaptain().isDefault() && !ship.getOriginalCaptain().isPlayer()) {
237                        return false;
238                }
239                
240                if (engine.isInCampaign() || engine.isInCampaignSim()) {
241                        if (Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.HAS_NEURAL_LINK).computeEffective(0f) <= 0) {
242                                return false;
243                        }
244                }
245                
246                boolean aliveOrDisabledButNonPhysical = ship.isAlive();
247                ShipAPI physicalLocation = engine.getShipPlayerLastTransferredCommandTo();
248                if (ship == playerShip && ship != physicalLocation) {
249                        aliveOrDisabledButNonPhysical = true;
250                }
251                                                
252                return aliveOrDisabledButNonPhysical && !ship.isShuttlePod() &&
253                           ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.HAS_NEURAL_LINK).computeEffective(0f) > 0;
254                           //ship.getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.NEURAL_INTERFACE);
255        }

257        public void updateLinkState() {
258                ShipAPI playerShip = engine.getPlayerShip();
259                if (playerShip == null) return;
260                
261                ShipAPI physicalLocation = engine.getShipPlayerLastTransferredCommandTo();
262                for (ShipAPI ship : new ArrayList<ShipAPI>(linked)) {
263                        if (!ship.isAlive()) {
264                                if (ship == playerShip && ship != physicalLocation) {
265                                        continue;
266                                }
267                                
268                                if (ship != playerShip) {
269                                        PersonAPI orig = ship.getOriginalCaptain();
270                                        if (orig.isPlayer()) {
271                                                orig = Global.getFactory().createPerson();
272                                                if (engine.isInCampaign() || engine.isInCampaignSim()) {
273                                                        orig.setPersonality(Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().pickPersonality());
274                                                }
275                                        }
276                                        ship.setCaptain(orig);
277                                }
278                                linked.remove(ship);
279                        }
280                }
281                
282                boolean physicallyPresent = linked.contains(physicalLocation);
283                if (!linked.contains(playerShip) || !physicallyPresent ||
284                                !canLink(playerShip)) {
285                        for (ShipAPI ship : linked) {
286                                PersonAPI orig = ship.getOriginalCaptain();
287                                if (orig.isPlayer()) {
288                                        orig = Global.getFactory().createPerson();
289                                        if (engine.isInCampaign() || engine.isInCampaignSim()) {
290                                                orig.setPersonality(Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().pickPersonality());
291                                        }
292                                }
293                                if (ship.getCaptain() != orig) {
294                                        ship.setCaptain(orig);
295                                        if (ship.getFleetMember() != null) {
296                                                ship.getFleetMember().setCaptain(ship.getOriginalCaptain());
297                                        }
298                                }
299                        }
300                        linked.clear();
301                        if (canLink(playerShip)) {
302                                linked.add(playerShip);
303                        }
304                }
305                
306                if (linked.isEmpty()) return;
307                
308                
309                CombatFleetManagerAPI manager = engine.getFleetManager(FleetSide.PLAYER);
310                List<DeployedFleetMemberAPI> members = manager.getDeployedCopyDFM();
311                
312                if (physicallyPresent) {
313                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI dfm : members) {
314                                if (linked.size() >= 2) break;
315                                
316                                if (dfm.isFighterWing()) continue;
317                                if (dfm.isAlly()) continue;
318                                
319                                ShipAPI ship = dfm.getShip();
320                                if (linked.contains(ship)) continue;
321                                if (!ship.getCaptain().isDefault() && ship != playerShip &&
322                                                !ship.getCaptain().isPlayer()) {
323                                        // this last for when the player deploys a ship with NI in the simulator and then
324                                        // deploys their actual flagship - so, the player ship doesn't *actually* have the player in it
325                                        // but the other ship does
326                                        continue;
327                                }
328                                
329                                // transferred command to an officer'ed ship, no link
330                                if (ship == playerShip && ship.getOriginalCaptain() != null && 
331                                                !ship.getOriginalCaptain().isDefault() &&
332                                                !ship.getOriginalCaptain().isPlayer()) {
333                                        continue;
334                                }
335                                if (ship.controlsLocked()) continue;
336                                
337                                if (canLink(ship)) {
338                                        linked.add(ship);
339                                }
340                        }
341                }
342                
343                PersonAPI player = playerPerson; 
344                if (player == null) {
345                        player = playerShip.getCaptain();
346                        if (!player.isDefault() && playerPerson == null) {
347                                playerPerson = player;
348                        }
349                }
350                
351                for (ShipAPI ship : linked) {
352                        if (ship.getCaptain() != player) {
353                                ship.setCaptain(player);
354                                if (ship.getFleetMember() != null) {
355                                        ship.getFleetMember().setCaptain(player);
356                                }
357                        }
358                }
359                
360                if (linked.contains(playerShip)) {
361                        ShipAPI other = null;
362                        for (ShipAPI ship : linked) {
363                                if (ship != playerShip) {
364                                        other = ship;
365                                        break;
366                                }
367                        }
368                        
369                        String title = "Neural System Reset";
370                        //String title = "System Reset on Transfer";
371                        String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_neural_link");
372                        String key = NeuralInterface.SYSTEM_RESET_TIMEOUT_KEY;
373//                      Float timeout = (Float) Global.getCombatEngine().getCustomData().get(key);
374//                      if (timeout == null) timeout = 0f;
375                        Float timeout = null;
376                        if (other != null) timeout = (Float) other.getCustomData().get(key);
377                        if (timeout == null) timeout = 0f;
378                        if (other == null) {
379                                engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_STATUS2, icon, title, "No signal", true);
380                        } else if (timeout <= 0) {
381                                engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_STATUS2, icon, title, "Ready on transfer", false);
382                        } else {
383                                int show = (int) Math.ceil(timeout);
384                                engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_STATUS2, icon, title, "Ready in " + show + " seconds", true);
385                        }
386                }
387                
388                for (ShipAPI ship : linked) {
389                        if (ship != playerShip) {
390                                
391                                if (untilTransfer <= 0f) {
392                                        String title = "Neural Link Active";
393                                        //String data = ship.getName() + ", " + ship.getHullSpec().getHullNameWithDashClass();
394                                        //String data = ship.getName() + ", " + ship.getHullSpec().getHullName();
395                                        String data = "Target: " + ship.getHullSpec().getHullNameWithDashClass();
396                                        String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_neural_link");
397                                        engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_STATUS, icon, title, data, false);
398                                } else {
399                                        int show = (int) Math.ceil(untilTransfer);
400                                        if (show > 0) {
401                                                String title = "Neural Transfer";
402                                                String data = "Link in " + show + " seconds";
403                                                String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_neural_link");
404                                                engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_STATUS, icon, title, data, true);
405                                        }
406                                }
407                                
408                                break;
409                        }
410                }
411                
412                if (linked.size() <= 1 && linked.contains(playerShip)) {
413                        String title = "Neural Link Inactive";
414                        String data = "No signal";
415                        if (!physicallyPresent) {
416                                data = "requires physical transfer";
417                        }
418                        String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_neural_link");
419                        engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_STATUS, icon, title, data, true);
420                }
421        }

424        public void processInputPreCoreControls(float amount, List<InputEventAPI> events) {
425                if (engine == null || engine.getCombatUI() == null || engine.getCombatUI().isShowingCommandUI()) return;
426                
427                ShipAPI playerShip = engine.getPlayerShip();
428                if (playerShip == null) return;
429                if (!linked.contains(playerShip) || linked.size() < 2) return;
430                //if (untilTransfer > 0) return;
431                
432                for (InputEventAPI event : events) {
433                        if (event.isConsumed()) continue;
434                        
435                        if (event.isControlDownEvent(TRANSFER_CONTROL)) {
436                                if (untilTransfer <= 0) {
437                                        for (ShipAPI ship : linked) {
438                                                if (ship != playerShip) {
439                                                        untilTransfer = getTransferTime();
440                                                        lastShownTime = 0;
441                                                        doTransfer(ship);
442                                                }
443                                        }
444                                }
445                                event.consume();
446                                return;
447                        }
448                }
449        }

451        
452        public void doTransfer(ShipAPI ship) {
453                if (ship == null) return;
454                ShipAPI playerShip = engine.getPlayerShip();
455                if (playerShip == null) return;
456                if (!linked.contains(playerShip)) return;
457                if (!linked.contains(ship)) return;
458                
459                if (untilTransfer <= 0) {
460                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_neural_transfer_complete", 1f, 1f);
461                        ship.setCustomData(TRANSFER_COMPLETE_KEY, true);
462                        showTranferFloatyIfNeeded();
463                        engine.getCombatUI().reFanOutShipInfo();
464                } else {
465                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_neural_transfer_begin", 1f, 1f);
466                }
467                
468                // I have it on good authority that this looks bad.
469                // "[it looks like] some vague energy field effect, then like Troi would have a headache and some dubious writing would occur"
470//              float animDur = Math.max(untilTransfer, 0.5f);
471//              engine.addLayeredRenderingPlugin(new NeuralTransferVisual(playerShip, ship, animDur));
472                
473                Mouse.setCursorPosition((int)Global.getSettings().getScreenWidthPixels()/2,
474                                                                (int)Global.getSettings().getScreenHeightPixels()/2);
475                
476                saveControlState(playerShip);
477                
478                ShipAIPlugin playerShipAI = playerShip.getShipAI(); // non-null if autopilot is on
479                ShipAIPlugin prevTargetAI = ship.getShipAI();
480                engine.setPlayerShipExternal(ship);
481                if (ship.getFleetMember() != null) {
482                        ship.getFleetMember().setCaptain(playerShip.getCaptain());
483                }
484                
485                if (playerShipAI != null) {
486                        playerShip.setShipAI(playerShipAI); // not the player ship anymore, the old ship
487                }
488                
489                if (playerShip.getShield() != null && playerShip.getShield().isOn()) {
490                        playerShip.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.KEEP_SHIELDS_ON, 1f);
491                } else if (playerShip.isReallyPhaseShip() && playerShip.getPhaseCloak() != null &&
492                                (playerShip.getPhaseCloak().isActive() || playerShip.getPhaseCloak().isChargeup())) {
493                        playerShip.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.STAY_PHASED, 1f);
494                }
495                
496                boolean autopilot = engine.getCombatUI().isAutopilotOn();
497                
498                if (untilTransfer > 0) {
499                        if (!ALLOW_ENGINE_CONTROL_DURING_TRANSFER) {
500                                ship.setShipAI(prevTargetAI);
501                        }
502                        //engine.getCombatUI().setDisablePlayerShipControlOneFrame(true);
503                        suppressControlsDuringTransfer(ship);
504                        showTranferFloatyIfNeeded();
505                } else if (autopilot) {
506                        CombatFleetManagerAPI manager = engine.getFleetManager(FleetSide.PLAYER);
507                        DeployedFleetMemberAPI member = manager.getDeployedFleetMember(ship);
508                        ship.setShipAI(Global.getSettings().pickShipAIPlugin(member == null ? null : member.getMember(), ship));
509                }
510                
511                if (untilTransfer <= 0) {
512                        showTranferFloatyIfNeeded();
513                        if (!autopilot) {
514                                restoreControlState(ship);
515                        }
516                }
517        }

519        
520        public float getTransferTime() {
521                float total = 0f;
522                boolean instant = false;
523                for (ShipAPI ship : linked) {
524                        if (ship.getFleetMember() == null) continue;
525                        total += ship.getFleetMember().getDeploymentPointsCost();
526                        if (ship == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip() &&
527                                        ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.INSTANT_NEURAL_TRANSFER_FROM, 0f) > 0f) {
528                                instant = true;
529                        }
530                }
531                
532                total = Math.round(total);
533                if (instant) total = 0f;
534                
535                //INSTANT_TRANSFER_DP = 0f;
536                
537                if (total <= INSTANT_TRANSFER_DP) return 0f;
538                
539                float time = (total - INSTANT_TRANSFER_DP) * TRANSFER_SECONDS_PER_DP;
540                if (time < TRANSFER_MIN_SECONDS_IF_NOT_INSTANT) {
541                        time = TRANSFER_MIN_SECONDS_IF_NOT_INSTANT;
542                } else if (time > TRANSFER_MAX_SECONDS) {
543                        time = TRANSFER_MAX_SECONDS;
544                }
545                time = (float) Math.ceil(time);
546
547                return time;
548        }

557        public static float getFloatySize(ShipAPI ship) {
558                switch (ship.getHullSize()) {
559                case FIGHTER: return 15f;
560                case FRIGATE: return 17f;
561                case DESTROYER: return 21f;
562                case CRUISER: return 24f;
563                case CAPITAL_SHIP: return 27f;
564                }
565                return 10f;
566        }
